text:
hana: quick heads-up - ran into a parity issue with the Ruby SDK vs REST while testing the artifact upload flow in sample-apps/ruby-uploader. REST honors `cache_control` on upload; Ruby SDK drops it and then the infra eviction behaves differently.

mike: repro steps?

hana: snippet: ```ruby
# ruby SDK v0.4.0
client.artifacts.create(name: 'model-v1', file: File.open('m.bin'), cache_control: 'max-age=3600')
# -> server stored artifact but cache_control missing
```

hana: when I curl the same body including cache_control it shows up fine in the server metadata.

julia: do you have the proxied request body? could be symbol vs string key serialization in the Ruby client.

hana: proxied JSON from SDK: {"name":"model-v1","file":"<binary>","metadata":{}}. REST curl: {"name":"model-v1","file":"<binary>","cache_control":"max-age=3600"} . So key is missing entirely.

mike: Ruby libs sometimes drop keys when value is nil or when using keyword args not forwarded to the serializer. Might be a generate vs handwritten client mismatch.

julia: also noticed retry divergence: REST does a single retry on 502, but Ruby SDK retries 4x with short backoff which resulted in duplicate uploads and caused the storage layer to bill twice. Customer flagged unexpected billing.

hana: exact error logs: server accepted artifact once but monitoring shows two PUTs within 1s. SDK logs show 4 attempts.

mike: action items:
- regen ruby client model for artifact.create and ensure `cache_control` is included and serialized as a top-level key (not nested into metadata)
- change Ruby SDK retry policy to match infra defaults (single retry for 502) and add idempotency token header to artifact uploads so server can dedupe
- add a parity e2e test in CI that posts via SDK and via curl and diffs the JSON seen by the server for artifact endpoints

julia: I'll take the serializer fix. mike, can you own retry/idempotency work?

mike: yes. I'll also add an instrumented unit test that asserts only one final PUT is observed when server returns transient 502s.

ci-bot: Created issue redwood/ruby-sdk#77: "ruby SDK: artifact.create omits cache_control; aggressive retry causes duplicate uploads" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/issues/77 :robot_face:

hana: temporary workaround in sample-apps is to call REST directly from the Ruby demo for artifact uploads and include an idempotency key. I'll open a small PR to switch to REST until SDK patch lands.

julia: good call. Also scan other Ruby endpoints that accept top-level string props (priority, cache_control, response_headers) - could be a broader symbol/string conversion bug.

mike: marking P1 for parity backlog since this impacts billing and eviction behavior.

hana: thanks all, will link PR and tests once ready.
